name: sample_frame
description: Render a fully composited project frame at a given timestamp to PNG, or at several timestamps to one labelled sheet (video + image items + active overlay JSXs + the captions, drawn as the export draws them; no audio). With scene, render one 3D alone over the project's whole frame, at seconds into it.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: PNG file at the requested output path (defaults to <project_dir>/render/samples/frame-<at>s.png, or sheet-<first>-<last>s.png for several times)

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Seconds on the timeline (with scene, into that 3D). One: a full frame. Several (up to 120): labelled sheets on the 1280 px look layout, 24 a sheet. Not with every.

params.name: every
params.description: A sheet of the whole project: a frame every N seconds (not with at). The timeline's one look; the closing check is look.

params.name: scene
params.description: Sample one 3D alone over the project's whole frame instead of the timeline, so a 3D no timeline item shows can be checked: the id of a 3D saved under models/scenes/<id>/, or an empty string for the project's own (models/active.json). at is then seconds into that 3D. Omit to sample the timeline.

params.name: sdr-curve
params.description: Look curve id for the HDR-to-SDR grade (one of: 'natural1', the default and what the editor preview shows; 'vivid1'; 'vivid1-neutral'). Meaningless on SDR projects: ignored with a stderr warning, not an error. Omit to use the default look.

params.name: prefer-proxy
params.description: Decode each clip from its SDR proxy (proxySrc) instead of the full-resolution master when a proxy exists. Much faster for quick previews (cover posters, cover-frame grids); the proxy is already SDR so no HDR tone-map is applied. Do NOT combine with --sdr-curve: the proxy is baked at the default look and cannot show a per-curve grade. Falls back to the master per clip when no proxy is present.

params.name: raw
params.description: Sample the untouched SOURCE frame under the time instead of the composite: the clip the timeline shows at that time, decoded straight from its file, with no crop, zoom, fit, grade, image items, overlays or captions. Use it to read the footage itself (e.g. to pick crops or cut points) without making a stripped copy of the project. Source resolution; an HDR source is not tone-mapped. A time with no video gives a black frame. Not combined with scene.

params.name: no-captions
params.description: Sample the frame without the captions overlay, to read the picture under a caption. No effect with raw or scene.

params.name: out
params.description: Output PNG path (with several times, the sheet). Defaults to <project_dir>/render/samples/frame-<at>s.png, or sheet-<first>-<last>s.png for several times
